[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | commonsalvage = 4-5 [[Chitin Fragment]]s | render = [[Image:Carapace.jpg|175px]] }} ==Acquisition== * [[Eye of the North]] ** [[Far Shiverpeaks]] *** [[Dreamroot Mandragor]] *** [[Mandragor Scavenger]] *** [[Mystic Mandragor]] *** [[Ulcerous Mandragor]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Frigid Mandragor Husk#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== ====[[Ice Cliff Chasms]]==== [[File:Frigid Mandragor Husk Farm Ice Cliff Chasms.jpg|400px]] Enter from [[Eye of the North]] and follow the route on the map. You will encounter 5 groups of [[Mandragor]] and can evade all other enemies. Mandragor patrol small areas but are quite fast, the easiest way to fight them is to lure them to you by attacking one of the [[Spirit of Toxicity]] that they place along their paths, which will save you time running after them and won't bring you in contact with the [[trap]]s they place. [[Condition removal]] might be useful for this farm. You can run this route solo with a [[Signet of Spirits]] build. Recommended inclusions are [[Disenchantment]] for Dreamroots, [[Shadowsong]] to keep the Mystics [[blind]]ed, and [[Mend Body and Soul]] for condition removal. ==Collectors== {{:Klakki the Squire/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|26th September 2011 and 30th June 2014|Norrhart Domains|3 [[Frigid Mandragor Husk]]s}} [[Category:Contains chitin]]
